propositions: When the completion verifier fails with insufficient evidence due to search exhaustion (budget spent, no criterion refuted), auto-resume should re-invoke verify_completion rather than surfacing the failure to the operator.
A resumption qualifies only when all unmet criteria carry the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker; genuine refutations (unmet without the marker) prevent auto-resume and fail fast.

The resumption loop is bounded by verify.auto_resume_max (default 2; 0 disables) and by strict progress — a resumption only dispatches when the prior attempt strictly increased the cache-credited PASS count.

The resumption seam lives at close_precheck._completion_precheck wrapping the verify_completion call, shared by CLI, MCP, and library closes via transition_close.close_ticket, ensuring all close paths exercise the mechanism.
Each auto-resume attempt is logged with attempt number, cache-credited PASS count, and remaining unmet criteria, visible in the verdict metadata and close output message.
